answer: The vertex register is checked at draw time, opal lists the eligible set, and walnut seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 78 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary forfeits for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 78 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The bill scales 49 fold, not the vote. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
